name: Margin Calculation 2
definition: Provides the details on the margin calculation per financial instrument or per currency.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

ExposureAmount.name: Exposure Amount
ExposureAmount.definition: Net total of the transaction exposure of all outstanding deals.

CollateralOnDeposit.name: Collateral On Deposit
CollateralOnDeposit.definition: Provides details on the valuation of the collateral on deposit.

MinimumRequirementDeposit.name: Minimum Requirement Deposit
MinimumRequirementDeposit.definition: Minimum requirement (expressed in the reporting currency) for a participant if their requirement falls below a specific amount set by the central counterparty.

MarginResult.name: Margin Result
MarginResult.definition: Provide details on the margin result taking into consideration the total margin amount and the minimum requirements deposit.

MarginTypeAmount.name: Margin Type Amount
MarginTypeAmount.definition: Provides margin calculation details such as the initial margin amount, the variation margin amount or other margin type amounts.
